name: Proof of Demise

meta.previous: At War With The Scarlet Crusade (Classic)

summary: In Brill, Proof of Demise sends soldiers against the Scarlet Crusade across Tirisfal Glades. Varimathras, Sylvanas Windrunner's dreadlord lieutenant, orders the campaign to thin their ranks and test loyalty to the Forsaken cause. Recruits must take signet rings from fallen crusaders as proof.

sections.title: A Mandate from the Dreadlord
sections.body:
Across northern Tirisfal Glades, the Forsaken wage a coordinated war against the living. Varimathras surrendered and pledged his blade to Sylvanas Windrunner. He oversees many of the Forsaken's aggressive military maneuvers.

His orders pass to commanders such as Executor Zygand, then to frontline officers like Deathguard Burgess. Burgess makes the order plain: humans are vermin to be purged from Lordaeron, and nearby crusaders are the immediate target.

sections.title: Tokens of Slaughter
sections.body:
In Brill, words alone do not satisfy the commanders. Soldiers must take Scarlet Insignia Rings from the fingers of slain zealots to prove obedience to the Dark Lady and her lieutenant. The rings bear the Scarlet Crusade's mark, identifying their bearers as sworn enemies of the Forsaken.

Bring back these trophies, and the dead crusaders are proved. The rings also show a soldier's allegiance to the Forsaken leadership.

faq.q: Who assigns the task to collect these rings?
faq.answer: Deathguard Burgess, a Forsaken guard in Brill, gives the order. He acts on reports from Executor Zygand and follows the military goals set by Varimathras.

faq.q: Why does Burgess demand Scarlet Insignia Rings specifically?
faq.answer: Scarlet Insignia Rings provide physical proof that a crusader has been slain. The zealots carry them as personal tokens, making them clear trophies that confirm a soldier's loyalty to Forsaken leadership.

faq.q: Who is Varimathras and why is he mentioned?
faq.answer: Varimathras is a dreadlord who allied with Queen Sylvanas Windrunner after the Forsaken broke free from the Lich King. He is now her chief lieutenant in the Undercity and directs military strategy against the remaining human enclaves in Lordaeron, including the Scarlet Crusade.

faq.q: Where are the Scarlet Crusaders located for this task?
faq.answer: Scarlet zealots hold several armed camps across Tirisfal Glades. They gather around watchtowers, garrisons, and outposts in the northern and eastern woods.

faq.q: How does this connect to Executor Zygand's orders?
aliases: at war with the scarlet crusade link
faq.answer: Executor Zygand oversees the wider campaign against the Scarlet Crusade from Brill. He directs recruits against the crusaders' field presence, while Burgess demands personal trophies as proof of obedience to Varimathras and the Dark Lady.

faq.q: Why is the Forsaken leadership so hostile to the Scarlet Crusade?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade calls all undead abominations destined for holy fire, making no distinction between the mindless Scourge and the free-willed Forsaken. Its members hunt the Forsaken along their borders, so Sylvanas and her officers see the crusaders as a dangerous threat that must be annihilated.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, each crusader ring brought to Brill means one fewer fanatic sworn to cleanse Lordaeron of free-willed undead.
This task reveals the ruthless, total-war spirit of Sylvanas's northern regime, directed in part by the dreadlord Varimathras.
